limitations: Explicitly approved Swiss PET-market FLUWA screening proxy (2026-11-07): use the complete CH UVEK municipal-incineration service for the source fly-ash-extraction incinerator at its original treatment fraction. Both treat the same 0.2%-water PET per wet kg. UVEK does not model the source FLUWA extraction and recovered zinc-bearing hydroxide sludge; ash treatment, recovery, emissions, energy recovery and allocation differ. Do not add a zinc, sludge, energy or avoided-production credit and do not claim equivalence. Retain every original open-dump/open-burning fraction using its unchanged complete source-inventory helper; do not omit any other source component or normalize the fractions. Preserve all original road and later diesel/electric rail tonne-km. Rail helpers retain the inspected country/traction weights without normalization using complete CH diesel-with-filter and electric-with-shunting services; the complete RER road fleet approximates source size/EURO/geographic mixes. Fuel/energy, vehicles, maintenance and infrastructure are included; vintage, technology, loading, filter, shunting, gauge and geographic differences remain, without fuel/capacity/lifetime rescaling. Source market reference -1kg becomes helper +1kg with caller factor -1; each original negative treatment input uses its independently checked -1 factor. Preserve caller signed quantities, supported uncertainty/bounds/formulas, metadata, foreground suppliers, production, separate transport/credits/emissions; internal source uncertainty/parameter formulas are not reconstructed. Score/export all returned helpers. Only these nine exact Swiss cut-off market profiles are approved, including independently inspected original 3.9.1 and 3.10.1. No global FAE-incinerator mapping, biowaste technology proxy, consequential route, inverse correspondence, new physical-flow proxy, negative-empty allocation or extension of earlier land-class scopes is approved. Existing native physical-biosphere completeness/indicator policies remain independent.
